William Shakespeare and John Fletcher, The Two Noble Kinsmen.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/william-shakespeare_john-fletcher/the-two-noble-kinsmen

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- William Shakespeare, the author, died 1616 (Wikidata Q692; every death date recorded for this person falls in 1616).
- John Fletcher, the author, died 1625 (Wikidata Q312444; every death date recorded for this person falls in 1625).

First publication of the text used: 1613 (SE colophon: 'The Two Noble Kinsmen was published in 1613 by William Shakespeare and John Fletcher.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1613, before 1931, so it is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: the text was first published in England (United Kingdom), but the country does not change the result. The last person to die did so in 1625, more than 100 years before 2026. The work is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.
